sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What do you say to your teacher when you enter the class in the morning?
Choose the correct article: I have ___ orange in my bag.
In the story 'The Cap Seller and the Monkeys', where did the cap seller sleep?
Choose the correct pronoun: ___ is a good boy.
Which season do we like to eat ice cream and wear cotton clothes?
According to the poem, what do two little hands do?
Choose the correct action word: The bird can ___ in the sky.
Which of these is a healthy food to eat every day?
Choose the correct position word: The cat is sitting ___ the mat.
What are three colours you can see in Anandi's rainbow? (Maximum 10 words)
questions.answer: I can see red, blue, and yellow.

questions.question_text: Name any two animals you can find on a farm. (Maximum 10 words)
questions.answer: We can find a cow and a horse.

questions.question_text: Why did the cap seller throw his cap on the ground? (Maximum 15 words)
questions.answer: He threw his cap so the monkeys would copy him and throw theirs too.

questions.question_text: What do you say when you make a mistake? (Maximum 5 words)
Write one sentence about your favourite season. (Maximum 15 words)
questions.answer: My favourite season is winter because I love to wear warm sweaters.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with 'A' or 'An': 1. ___ umbrella, 2. ___ ball, 3. ___ elephant, 4. ___ kite, 5. ___ owl.
Match the naming word to the correct describing word (Green, Hot, Small, Cold, Yellow): 1. Sun, 2. Grass, 3. Ice, 4. Mouse, 5. Fire.
questions.answer: 1. Sun - Yellow, 2. Grass - Green, 3. Ice - Cold, 4. Mouse - Small, 5. Fire - Hot

questions.question_text: Imagine you are playing in a park. Write three simple sentences about what you see and do there.
questions.answer: I am at the park with my friends. I see a big green tree. I love playing on the slide.

questions.question_text: What is your favourite healthy food? Write two sentences telling why you like it.
questions.answer: My favourite healthy food is a banana. It is sweet and gives me energy to play.
